text:
lee-support: FYI customer reported intermittent parse failures for JSON mode in their production requests. Happens ~5% of calls, usually after a latency spike. They see truncated JSON (missing closing brace) and our SDK fails the parse. Ticket #44321.

sam-eng: can you paste the raw response they got? also which model / streaming on/off?

lee-support: non-streaming, model=redwood-open-v1. Sample response:
```json
{"user":{"id":123,"name":"acme"},"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2},
```
truncated — missing closing ] and }.

julia-sre: interesting — truncation + latency spike suggests connection cut or payload limit during response. Any 4xx/5xx around that time in logs?

lee-support: opsbot shows a spike in 524 gateway at 2024-05-21T14:02:03Z. Also a few 429s for the customer's org id 9876 around same minute.

sam-eng: hypothesis: streaming/chunk assembly bug or rate-limit causing server to abort stream mid-response. If non-streaming request is proxied through our streaming layer and connection reset occurs, you can get partial payload.

andre-devex: quick repro for engineers: run the same prompt with a small max_tokens and artificially throttle network (tc qdisc) to simulate cut. Also test with streaming=true to see chunk boundaries.

sam-eng: mitigation plan:
- client-side: exponential backoff + re-ask (up to 3 attempts). Re-ask prompt: "Output ONLY valid JSON for this schema. If your response would be truncated, instead return a short error message in JSON."
- server-side: sanitizer proxy that attempts self-heal on partial JSON using heuristics (append closing brackets, regex to drop trailing commas) before failing.
- policy: if 429 or connection reset seen during response, mark as transient and retry with jitter.

lee-support: can you share the regex rules you use for sanitizer? customer asked for details.

sam-eng: simple heuristics we use (non-exhaustive):
- if response ends with "," -> drop trailing comma: regex s/,(\s*)$//
- if response ends with "}," -> replace "}," with "}" (for trailing element)
- if braces count mismatch -> try append matching closers in order: if open_braces>close_braces append '}'*diff, same for brackets.
- if append step yields invalid JSON -> fallback to re-ask with guided prompt.

julia-sre: add guard: only apply sanitizer when body length < 256k and when there was an upstream 5xx/524 or 429. We don't want to mask real generator errors.

andre-devex: sample retry config to recommend to customers:
```yaml
retries:
  attempts: 3
  backoff:
    type: expo
    base_ms: 300
    max_ms: 5000
    jitter: true
  on_status: [429, 502, 503, 504]
  on_partial_body: true
```

sam-eng: also recommend client change: if parse fails, don't immediately surface to user — try run sanitizer then one re-ask with prompt: "Your previous response was missing closing JSON. Please provide the complete JSON response now; if unable, return {"error":"incomplete_response"}." Limit to 1 re-ask to avoid loops.

lee-support: customer also reported auth error 401 for some calls during the spike. Could be billing threshold bounce we saw last week.

julia-sre: check token service logs: if auth service revokes tokens when billing flags flip, that would show 401s. But the partial JSON problem still happens independent of 401s (different users). Could be high-load degradation.

sam-eng: operational checklist for escalations:
1) get raw_response + request_id + model + streaming flag
2) check ingress/egress logs + 5xx/524/429 window
3) attempt offline sanitizer + parse; if sanitized, provide patch and ask customer to switch to client retry policy
4) if reproducible, open eng-runtime issue with sample and network sim steps

andre-devex: small prompt nudge we recommend to users (works often):
"Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include any explanatory text. If you cannot produce the full JSON, return {"error":"truncated_output"}."

deploy-bot: canary deploy r-inference/2024.05.18-rc3 -> live in us-west-2 at 2024-05-21T13:50:12Z

julia-sre: follow-ups: sam, can you add a short KB article for support with repro steps + sanitizer rules? lee, send the customer the recommended client config and the re-ask helper prompt. I'll monitor for another 24h for recurrence.

sam-eng: will open ENG-7893 with the sample and attach network throttling repro. I'll also publish small JS/py snippet for sanitizer we use.

lee-support: sending message to customer now with recommended config + we will enable extra logging for 24h. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
